name: Overnight Oats
author: Maxwell Stelmack on based.cooking
steps: Slice bananas into a few pieces each and add to blender, blend until combined.
Scoop yogurt into blender and blend until combined.
Scoop peanut butter into blender and blend until combined.
If using eggs, scramble and cook them on the stove. Add them to blender and blend until combined.
Divide blender contents between 3 storage containers, such as tupperware.
Mix each container throughoughly so that the oats are well distributed and are not clumped together.
Let soak in refridgerator for at least 12 hours.
